question: In the review of lithium-mediated ammonia electrosynthesis, what shares of global energy consumption and of global CO2 emissions are attributed to the Haber–Bosch process?
rendered: According to the excerpt from "Pathways to sustainable lithium-mediated ammonia electrosynthesis: tuning reaction environment and advancing reactor design, page 1", the Haber–Bosch process accounts for approximately 2% of global energy consumption and 1.8% of global CO2 emissions, primarily due to the steam-reforming of methane for H2 production.
